blocks.text: TOKYO, Japan — Binibining Pilipinas Katrina Anne Johnson may be carrying the Philippines across her chest at the 2026 Miss International pageant, but there are other delegates who are also bringing Filipino pride with them in the competition. Alejandra Ranaudo from the US Virgin Islands is fielded by JDP Pageants of Los Angeles-based Filipino national director Jacqueline del Pilar, who assembled a team composed entirely of Filipinos for her bet’s Miss International journey. She has been sending delegates to the Miss International pageant since 2024, and last year’s candidate Sikeza Fowlks also had an all-Filipino team behind her. Del Pilar tapped […]...
